title: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation accepted by the UE

entities.name: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation
entities.description: Procedure for activating a dedicated EPS bearer context in response to network request.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Network-initiated message to activate a dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: UE response message accepting the dedicated EPS bearer context activation.

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: Timer associated with APN or no APN context, stopped upon dedicated bearer activation.

entities.name: Timer T3485
entities.description: MME timer stopped upon receiving ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by UE and MME after successful dedicated bearer activation.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the dedicated EPS bearer being activated.

entities.name: Linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Indicates the default bearer to which the dedicated bearer is linked.

entities.name: Traffic Flow Template (TFT)
entities.description: Used for mapping uplink traffic flows to the radio bearer.

entities.name: Procedure Transaction Identity (PTI)
entities.description: Identifies UE-initiated procedures related to bearer resource allocation/modification.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Contains various parameters including APN rate control, small data rate control, and QoS rules.

entities.name: Emergency PDN connection
entities.description: Condition where dedicated bearer activation is for emergency services.

entities.name: TFT validation
entities.description: UE checks received TFT before taking it into use.

relations.description: Procedure begins with receipt of ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.
Procedure includes sending ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT.
Procedure stops timer T3396 under specified conditions.
Procedure results in entering BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE state.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT includes EPS bearer identity.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST includes linked EPS bearer identity.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST includes TFT.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST may include PTI.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST includes protocol configuration options IE.
Emergency PDN connection condition prevents stopping timer T3396.
Procedure includes TFT validation before use.
Receipt of ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT stops MME timer T3485.
Receipt of ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT causes MME to enter BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE state.
